name: shared-expense-tracker
description: Group & Roommate Expense Tracker with Angular 21, Node.js, Turso libSQL, and Google Sheets

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend
